text.p: ATNN Inc said on Monday it entered into an agreement to buy EuroTelecom Communications Inc, in a stock deal which also involved all of ATNN's previous management resigning.
Under the deal, ATNN would change its name to EuroTelecom Communications.
EuroTelecom would appoint P. Hinchcliff as chairman and P.S. Derry as president and chief executive, ATNN said.

EuroTelecom had a strategy for facilitating the development of an intelligent site information management systems, ATNN said. This let site developers deliver business applications and facilities management systems over a single communications network, it said.
ATNN said it would issue a total of 5.9 million post-reverse split shares of the company's common stock, plus another 958,077 shares for consultants.
The company said its remaining 11.7 million common shares would be reverse-split on about a one-for-117 basis when the deal closed on July 28.
